title: Yabarana language - Wikipedia
text: Yawarana is a member of the Cariban language family. Their first mention as such was in 1782 by the Jesuit Filippo Salvatore Gilii, who obtained the information from the Tamanaku. Girard (1971) grouped Yawarana with Mapoyo in his eighth subgroup out of 15 which he had devised for the Cariban family.
